svg.text: fd13_l1i: the MSHR merge on line X
Requests for lines X and X+1, then X again. Line X has one memory request, and its fill answers both requests for it.
Addresses are 0x8000_0xxx: 800 is line X and 840 line X+1. Signal paths are under tb.dut unless they start with tb.
Empty cells: the signal is deasserted, or its payload is not valid. Requests are shown in cycles with ifu_l1i_req_val and ifu_l1i_req_rdy asserted.
A column is the interval with tb.cyc at its value. The memory response is driven by the testbench one time unit after the clock edge, so its beats fill
columns 190 and 191, and the markers of cyc 191 and 192 show them.
